svg.title: Figure 5: Cancer-type-associated variation in TCGA bulk expression across previously defined CGT candidate score sets
svg.desc: Six panels report cohort QC, within-cohort score transformations, a TCGA-fitted PCA with all 33 cancer-type centroids, relative cancer-type score profiles, in-sample between-cancer-type variance fractions, and remaining residual score dependence.
svg.title: CGT Figure 5 | Cancer-type-associated variation in TCGA bulk expression

cc:Work.dc:title: CGT Figure 5 | Cancer-type-associated variation in TCGA bulk expression
cc:Work.dc:description: Descriptive TCGA analysis using previously defined CGT-derived candidate score sets
